subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which linked SecretRef docs generator implementation should be treated as the canonical fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main still needs the change, but two open PRs overlap on the same generator/check surface and one is directly linked as closing this issue.

options.title: Refresh the stronger sibling PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as canonical, resolve conflicts, regenerate artifacts on current main, and rerun focused proof before merge.

options.title: Repair the same-author closing PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 to address its proof and formatter concerns, then land it as the direct closing PR.

options.title: Open a narrow replacement
options.body: If both branches are too stale or conflicting, open one narrow replacement that preserves useful contributor credit and close the competing PRs afterward.

recommendation.title: Refresh the stronger sibling PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as canonical, resolve conflicts, regenerate artifacts on current main, and rerun focused proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows recent adjacent work on credential matrix docs and enough routing context to pick the canonical implementation path.
